countries.title: Countries
countries.description: ISO codes to build, one after the other (never two downloads at once). Supported: US, CA, FR, DE, GB, NL, AU. Empty input builds nothing.

allowDownload.title: Allow the Geofabrik download
allowDownload.description: Safety switch. Without it the Actor only reports what it would download. Set it only with the founder's go.

pbfUrl.title: Extract URL override
pbfUrl.description: Optional. Overrides the Geofabrik URL of a single country (for a dated extract). Must be on download.geofabrik.de.

force.title: Rebuild within 7 days
force.description: Geofabrik etiquette allows a full rebuild at most weekly; without this a country built less than 7 days ago is skipped.
